case.summary: This case was triggered by a customer report regarding an unrecognized $49.00 purchase on card C08623-K2. The graph analysis showed that billing region 330 is routine for this card with 42 earlier purchases, yielding a case-memory model fraud rate of 0.8%, but the card has 5 earlier confirmed fraud cases and the simulated customer reply denied the transaction. The final verdict is uncertain with the fraud probability increasing from 0.17 to 0.63. The recommended actions include blocking the card (route L1, pending approval), creating a case (auto), and escalating to an analyst (auto).

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Assumed: the cardholder confirms they still hold the card and did not make or authorise transaction 3530164 ($49.00). Basis: the cardholder's own report, although the graph evidence alone points to normal use (graph-only probability 0.01).
